part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `preceding()` at lucene/analysis/opennlp/src/java/org/apache/lucene/analysis/opennlp/OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator.java:199 — the binary search started at `sentenceStarts.length / 2`, which for a 2-sentence text pointed at the last index, causing `sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1]` to throw `ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException`. Changed it to `(sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2`, matching `following()`.

Validation: full `:lucene:analysis:opennlp:test` suite passes — 33/33 tests, including the new `testPrecedingWithTwoSentences` regression case.
